title: They Nailed Him to the Tree

request.style: English, African-American spiritual, a lone elderly male voice moaning the melody, a small congregation answering softly, no instruments, very slow, grief-stricken, 54 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
They led him up to Calvary
Oh, Lord
They nailed him to the tree
Oh, Lord
Father, forgive them, he said
Oh, Lord
They know not what they do
Oh, Lord

[Chorus]
It makes me tremble, tremble
When I think how he died
It makes me tremble, tremble
When I think how he died

[Verse]
The sun refused to shine
Oh, Lord
The temple curtain tore
Oh, Lord
Into your hands, he cried
Oh, Lord
I give my spirit, Lord
Oh, Lord

[Chorus]
It makes me tremble, tremble
When I think how he died
It makes me tremble, tremble
When I think how he died
